title: 12 South Neighborhood: Home w/ Modern Flair!
description:
3 Mi to Broadway | Stroll to Cafés & Shops | Remote Work Setup

Discover the rhythm of Nashville from this bright and breezy, 1-bedroom, 1-bath vacation rental house. Whether sipping coffee at a local spot, hunting for vintage treasures, or cruising down Music Row, you’ll feel the city’s creative pulse around every corner. Back home, unwind on the deck, prepare a Southern-inspired dish, or catch up on business. Ready for fun? Downtown’s iconic live music scene is just a few miles away!

The space
CAZ10A001-2024055810

SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS 
- Bedroom: 1 queen bed 

MAIN FEATURES 
- Smart TV w/ cable 
- Dining bar 
- Laptop workspace 
- Deck & fully fenced yard

KITCHEN 
- Refrigerator, stove/oven, dishwasher 
- Nespresso coffee maker (pods provided) 
- Microwave, toaster, beer tap 
- Dishware/flatware, cooking basics 
- Trash bags & paper towels 

GENERAL 
- Free WiFi 
- Keyless entry 
- Central A/C & heating, ceiling fans 
- Linens/towels, complimentary toiletries 
- Washer & dryer, laundry detergent 

FAQ 
- 2 exterior security cameras (facing out) 
- Homeowner on-site (main house) 

ACCESSIBILITY 
- 2-story home, 4 steps to enter 
- Bedroom & full bathroom on 2nd floor

PARKING 
- Driveway in alley (2 vehicles)

Guest access
Guests will have access to the entire property via keyless entry

Other things to note
- No smoking
- No pets allowed
- No events, parties, or large gatherings
- Must be at least 25 years old to book
- Additional fees and taxes may apply
- Photo ID may be required upon check-in

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
- This 2-story home requires 4 steps to enter; the bedroom and full bathroom are located on the 2nd floor
- The homeowner lives on-site, in the main house with a separate entrance, and may be present during your stay
- Your safety matters. This property features 2 exterior security cameras: 1 camera is on the front of the home facing the driveway and alley, and 1 camera is next to the front door facing the front entry area. These cameras are outward facing and record sound and video continuously while guests are in residence
